title: Admin Web V2 Settings Mutation Authority
problem: Admin Web V2 has a read-only /settings route, but no accepted Admin API or source-of-truth model for safely mutating global settings.
gates: cd apps/admin-web && npm run generate:admin-api && npm run check && npm run test && npm run build

evidence.summary: Opened the settings mutation authority lane after the read-only System Settings route closeout and documented that current system config is diagnostic-only.

Audited settings mutation readiness and found no safe global settings mutation surface because config, router state, runtime semaphores, and service resources are startup-owned. Split admin-settings-configuration-authority as the backend predecessor.

Backend predecessor closed with GET/PUT /admin/v1/settings/metadata/raw-cache, generated Admin contract, restart-required effect semantics, and focused Rust evidence. Admin Web UI may continue only for metadata raw cache settings.

Admin Web Settings consumes the raw-cache route through AdminDataSource, exposes live-only prepare/confirm save controls, disables mock fallback mutation, and renders success, error, and requires-restart states.

Verified focused Rust/API/Admin Web gates, full Admin Web tests, generated contract, production build, desktop/mobile browser smoke, and closeout docs. PostgreSQL contract remains skipped locally without NAKO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL.

continue_policy.notes: Settings mutation lane is closed for the metadata raw cache slice. Continue the broader Admin Web V2 goal with users/permissions/Library Access, or open a new backend authority lane before adding any additional settings mutation group.
